description: This Java class 'ModelBasedThingsFieldExpressionFactory' implements the 'ThingsFieldExpressionFactory' interface. It provides specialized field mapping for constructing filter, existence, and sort expressions related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework, utilizing a delegate factory and static field mappings.
